movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Kernel contains an unspecified vulnerability in the TrueType font parsing engine in win32k.sys in the kernel-mode drivers that allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via crafted font data in a Word document or web page.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Adminer Server-Side Request Forgery Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Adminer contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that, when exploited, allows a remote attacker to obtain potentially sensitive information.

movers24h.product: Secure Firewall Adaptive Security Appliance and Secure Firewall Threat Defense
movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Secure Firewall Adaptive Security (ASA) Appliance and Secure Firewall Threat Defense (FTD) Missing Authorization Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Cisco Secure Firewall Adaptive Security (ASA) Appliance and Secure Firewall Threat Defense (FTD) Software VPN Web Server contain a missing authorization vulnerability. This vulnerability could be chained with CVE-2025-20333.

movers24h.product: Secure Firewall Adaptive Security Appliance and Secure Firewall Threat Defense
movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Secure Firewall Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Secure Firewall Threat Defense (FTD) Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Cisco Secure Firewall Adaptive Security (ASA) Appliance and Secure Firewall Threat Defense (FTD) Software VPN Web Server contain a buffer overflow vulnerability that allows for remote code execution. This vulnerability could be chained with CVE-2025-20362.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: DrayTek Vigor Routers OS Command Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: DrayTek Vigor2960, Vigor300B, and Vigor3900 routers contain an OS command injection vulnerability due to an unknown function of the file /cgi-bin/mainfunction.cgi/apmcfgupload of the component web management interface.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: SAP NetWeaver Directory Traversal Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: SAP NetWeaver Application Server (AS) Java contains a directory traversal vulnerability in scheduler/ui/js/ffffffffbca41eb4/UIUtilJavaScriptJS that allows a remote attacker to read arbitrary files via a .. (dot dot) in the query string.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Edimax IC-7100 IP Camera OS Command Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Edimax IC-7100 IP camera contains an OS command injection vulnerability due to improper input sanitization that allows an attacker to achieve remote code execution via specially crafted requests. The impacted product could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Hitachi Vantara Pentaho BA Server Special Element Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Hitachi Vantara Pentaho BA Server contains a special element injection vulnerability that allows an attacker to inject Spring templates into properties files, allowing for arbitrary command execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Metabase GeoJSON API Local File Inclusion Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Metabase contains a local file inclusion vulnerability in the custom map support in the API to read GeoJSON formatted data.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft SharePoint Deserialization Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft SharePoint contains a deserialization vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: SonicWall SonicOS Improper Access Control Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: SonicWall SonicOS contains an improper access control vulnerability that could lead to unauthorized resource access and, under certain conditions, may cause the firewall to crash.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Draytek VigorConnect Path Traversal Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Draytek VigorConnect contains a path traversal vulnerability in the file download functionality of the WebServlet endpoint. An unauthenticated attacker could leverage this vulnerability to download arbitrary files from the underlying operating system with root privileges.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Internet Explorer Use-After-Free Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Internet Explorer contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via a crafted web site that triggers access to an object that (1) was not properly allocated or (2) is deleted, as demonstrated by a CDwnBindInfo object.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Oracle WebLogic Server OS Command Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Oracle WebLogic Server, a product within the Fusion Middleware suite, contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows an attacker to execute arbitrary code via a specially crafted HTTP request that includes a malicious XML document.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Roundcube Webmail SQL Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Roundcube Webmail is vulnerable to SQL injection via search or search_params.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Multiple SugarCRM Products Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Multiple SugarCRM products contain a remote code execution vulnerability in the EmailTemplates. Using a specially crafted request, custom PHP code can be injected through the EmailTemplates.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows incorrectly parses shortcuts in such a way that malicious code may be executed when the operating system displays the icon of a malicious shortcut file. An attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability could execute code as the logged-on user.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: NETGEAR Multiple Devices Exposure of Sensitive Information Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Multiple NETGEAR devices are prone to admin password disclosure via simple crafted requests to the web management server.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: SAP NetWeaver SQL Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: SQL injection vulnerability in the UDDI server in SAP NetWeaver J2EE Engine 7.40 allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary SQL commands via unspecified vectors.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Flash Player Memory Corruption Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Adobe Flash Player contains a memory corruption vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code or cause denial-of-service (DoS).

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Authenticode Signature Verification Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: The Authenticode Signature Verification function in Microsoft Windows (WinVerifyTrust) does not properly validate the digest of a signed portable executable (PE) file, which allows user-assisted remote attackers to execute code.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Schneider Electric U.motion Builder SQL Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: A SQL Injection vulnerability exists in U.motion Builder software which could cause unwanted code execution when an improper set of characters is entered.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Edge Memory Corruption Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: The Chakra JavaScript scripting engine in Microsoft Edge allows remote attackers to execute remote code or cause a denial of service (memory corruption) via a crafted web site.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Print Spooler Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Print Spooler contains an unspecified vulnerability which can allow for privilege escalation.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: VMware Tanzu Spring Cloud Config Directory Traversal Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Spring, by VMware Tanzu, Cloud Config contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows applications to serve arbitrary configuration files.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Drupal Core Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: In Drupal Core, some field types do not properly sanitize data from non-form sources. This can lead to arbitrary PHP code execution in some cases.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Ruby on Rails Directory Traversal Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Directory traversal vulnerability in Action View in Ruby on Rails allows remote attackers to read arbitrary files.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Elasticsearch Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Elasticsearch enables dynamic scripting, which allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary MVEL expressions and Java code.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Exim Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Heap-based buffer overflow in the string_vformat function in string.c in Exim before 4.70 allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via an SMTP session.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows AppX Deployment Service (AppXSVC) Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: A privilege escalation vulnerability exists when Windows AppXSVC improperly handles hard links. An attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability could run processes in an elevated context.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: NETGEAR DGN2200 Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: NETGEAR DGN2200 wireless routers contain a vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

movers24h.product: Small Business RV160, RV260, RV340, and RV345 Series Routers
movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Small Business RV Series Routers Stack-based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: A vulnerability in Cisco Small Business RV160, RV260, RV340, and RV345 Series Routers could allow an attacker to do any of the following: Execute arbitrary code elevate privileges, execute arbitrary commands, bypass authentication and authorization protections, fetch and run unsigned software, or cause a denial of service (DoS).

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Flash Player Arbitrary Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Adobe Flash Player allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service or possibly execute arbitrary code.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Internet Explorer Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: This vulnerability may corrupt memory in a way that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code in the context of the current user within Internet Explorer.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Office Stack-based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: A stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability exists in the parsing of RTF data in Microsoft Office and earlier allows an attacker to perform remote code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Office Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: A remote code execution vulnerability exists in Microsoft Office software when it fails to properly handle objects in memory.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: System Information Library for Node.JS Command Injection
movers24h.shortDescription: In this vulnerability, an attacker can send a malicious payload that will exploit the name parameter. After successful exploitation, attackers can execute remote.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Oracle Business Intelligence Enterprise Edition Path Transversal
movers24h.shortDescription: Path traversal vulnerability, where an attacker can target the preview FilePath parameter of the getPreviewImage function to get access to arbitrary system file.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Google Chromium V8 Type Confusion Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Google Chromium V8 Engine contains a type confusion vulnerability allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: IBM Data Risk Manager Security Bypass Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: IBM Data Risk Manager contains a security bypass vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to bypass security restrictions when configured with SAML authentication. By sending a specially crafted HTTP request, an attacker could exploit this vulnerability to bypass the authentication process and gain full administrative access to the system.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft .NET Framework Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft .NET Framework contains a remote code execution vulnerability when processing untrusted input that could allow an attacker to take control of an affected system.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows CryptoAPI Spoofing Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows CryptoAPI (Crypt32.dll) contains a spoofing vulnerability in the way it validates Elliptic Curve Cryptography (ECC) certificates. An attacker could exploit the vulnerability by using a spoofed code-signing certificate to sign a malicious executable, making it appear the file was from a trusted, legitimate source. A successful exploit could also allow the attacker to conduct man-in-the-middle attacks and decrypt confidential information on user connections to the affected software. The vulnerability is also known under the moniker of CurveBall.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Oracle WebLogic Server Unspecified Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Oracle WebLogic Server contains an unspecified vulnerability in the Console component with high impacts to confidentilaity, integrity, and availability.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: TVT NVMS-1000 Directory Traversal Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: TVT devices utilizing NVMS-1000 software contain a directory traversal vulnerability via GET /.. requests.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Unraid Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Unraid contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows attackers to gain access to the administrative interface. This CVE is chainable with CVE-2020-5847 for remote code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: ONLYOFFICE Docs Server Path Traversal Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: ONLYOFFICE Docs contains a path traversal vulnerability that can occur when JWT is used, via a /.. sequence in an image upload parameter and could allow for remote code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: ownCloud Improper Authentication Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: ownCloud contains an improper authentication vulnerability that allows an attacker to access, modify, or delete any file without authentication if the username of a victim is known, and the victim has no signing-key configured.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft SQL Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft SQL Server contains a remote code execution vulnerability that could allow an attacker to execute code in the context of the SQL Server Database Engine service account.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances Server-Side Request Forgery Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances contain a server-side request forgery vulnerability that could allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to potentially cause the appliance to make requests to unintended location.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Aquasecurity Trivy Embedded Malicious Code Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Aquasecurity Trivy contains an embedded malicious code vulnerability that could allow an attacker to gain access to everything in the CI/CD environment, including all tokens, SSH keys, cloud credentials, database passwords, and any sensitive configuration in memory.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Grafana Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Grafana contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated and unauthenticated users to view and delete all snapshot data, potentially resulting in complete snapshot data loss.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: VMware Tanzu Spring Cloud Function Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: When using routing functionality in VMware Tanzu's Spring Cloud Function, it is possible for a user to provide a specially crafted SpEL as a routing-expression that may result in remote code execution and access to local resources.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: SAP Multiple Products HTTP Request Smuggling Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: SAP NetWeaver Application Server ABAP, SAP NetWeaver Application Server Java, ABAP Platform, SAP Content Server and SAP Web Dispatcher allow HTTP request smuggling. An unauthenticated attacker can prepend a victim's request with arbitrary data, allowing for function execution impersonating the victim or poisoning intermediary Web caches.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains multiple, unspecified vulnerabilities which can allow for remote code execution when chained.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Atlassian Questions For Confluence App Hard-coded Credentials Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Atlassian Questions For Confluence App has hard-coded credentials, exposing the username and password in plaintext. A remote unauthenticated attacker can use these credentials to log into Confluence and access all content accessible to users in the confluence-users group.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Oracle WebLogic Server Unspecified Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Oracle WebLogic Server contains an unspecified vulnerability which can allow an unauthenticated attacker with T3 network access to compromise the server.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Sophos Firewall Code Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: A code injection vulnerability in the User Portal and Webadmin of Sophos Firewall allows for remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Zoho ManageEngine Multiple Products Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Zoho ManageEngine PAM360, Password Manager Pro, and Access Manager Plus contain an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Atlassian Bitbucket Server and Data Center Command Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Multiple API endpoints of Atlassian Bitbucket Server and Data Center contain a command injection vulnerability where an attacker with access to a public Bitbucket repository, or with read permissions to a private one, can execute code by sending a malicious HTTP request.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Flash Player Memory Corruption Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Adobe Flash Player contains a memory corruption vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code or cause denial-of-service (DoS).

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Authenticode Signature Verification Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: The Authenticode Signature Verification function in Microsoft Windows (WinVerifyTrust) does not properly validate the digest of a signed portable executable (PE) file, which allows user-assisted remote attackers to execute code.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: NETGEAR Multiple Devices Exposure of Sensitive Information Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Multiple NETGEAR devices are prone to admin password disclosure via simple crafted requests to the web management server.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows incorrectly parses shortcuts in such a way that malicious code may be executed when the operating system displays the icon of a malicious shortcut file. An attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability could execute code as the logged-on user.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Incorrect Resource Transfer Between Spheres Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains an incorrect resource transfer between spheres vulnerability that could allow for privilege escalation.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) Arbitrary File Upload Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains flaw in the mboximport functionality, allowing an authenticated attacker to upload arbitrary files to perform remote code execution. This vulnerability was chained with CVE-2022-37042 which allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Apache CouchDB Insecure Default Initialization of Resource Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Apache CouchDB contains an insecure default initialization of resource vulnerability which can allow an attacker to escalate to administrative privileges.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Apache APISIX Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Apache APISIX contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Oracle Fusion Middleware Unspecified Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Oracle Fusion Middleware Access Manager allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access via HTTP to takeover the Access Manager product.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Apache Tomcat Missing Encryption of Sensitive Data Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Apache Tomcat contains a missing encryption of sensitive data vulnerability that allows the bypass of the EncryptInterceptor. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE‑2025‑24813.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Acrobat and Reader Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Adobe Acrobat and Reader contain a buffer overflow vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code via a PDF file with long arguments to unspecified JavaScript methods.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Flash Player Memory Corruption Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Adobe Flash Player contains a memory corruption vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code or cause denial-of-service (DoS).

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: RARLAB UnRAR Directory Traversal Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: RARLAB UnRAR on Linux and UNIX contains a directory traversal vulnerability, allowing an attacker to write to files during an extract (unpack) operation.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: PEAR Archive_Tar Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: PEAR Archive_Tar allows an unserialization attack because phar: is blocked but PHAR: is not blocked. PEAR stands for PHP Extension and Application Repository and it is an open-source framework and distribution system for reusable PHP components with known usage in third-party products such as Drupal Core and Red Hat Linux.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) Command Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) allows an attacker to inject memcache commands into a targeted instance which causes an overwrite of arbitrary cached entries.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Apache ActiveMQ Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Apache ActiveMQ contains an improper input validation vulnerability that allows for code injection.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Acrobat and Reader Stack-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Adobe Acrobat and Reader contain a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code or cause denial-of-service (DoS).

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Reader and Acrobat Universal 3D Memory Corruption Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: The Universal 3D (U3D) component in Adobe Reader and Acrobat contains a memory corruption vulnerability which could allow remote attackers to execute code or cause denial-of-service (DoS).

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Acrobat and Reader Use-After-Free Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Use-after-free vulnerability in Adobe Acrobat and Reader allows remote attackers to execute code via a crafted PDF file.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Support Diagnostic Tool (MSDT) Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: A remote code execution vulnerability exists when MSDT is called using the URL protocol from a calling application such as Word. An attacker who successfully exploits this vulnerability can run code with the privileges of the calling application.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Exchange Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Exchange Server contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for authenticated remote code execution. Dubbed "ProxyNotShell," this vulnerability is chainable with CVE-2022-41040 which allows for the remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Office Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Office contains a buffer overflow vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code via crafted PNG data in an Office document.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Internet Explorer Use-After-Free Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Internet Explorer contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code via a crafted web site.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft XML Core Services Memory Corruption Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft XML Core Services contains a memory corruption vulnerability which could allow for remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Acrobat and Reader Universal 3D Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Adobe Acrobat and Reader contains an array boundary issue in Universal 3D (U3D) support that could lead to remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: D-Link DIR-820L Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: D-Link DIR-820L contains an unspecified vulnerability in Device Name parameter in /lan.asp which allows for remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Google Chromium V8 Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Google Chromium V8 Engine contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute code inside a sandbox via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Red Hat Polkit Out-of-Bounds Read and Write Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: The Red Hat polkit pkexec utility contains an out-of-bounds read and write vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation with administrative rights.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Active Directory Domain Services Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: An authenticated user could manipulate attributes on computer accounts they own or manage, and acquire a certificate from Active Directory Certificate Services that would allow for privilege escalation to SYSTEM.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows TS WebProxy Directory Traversal Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Directory traversal vulnerability in the TS WebProxy (TSWbPrxy) component in Microsoft Windows allows remote attackers to escalate privileges.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler Out-of-Bounds Read Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC (formerly Citrix ADC), NetScaler Gateway (formerly Citrix Gateway) and NetScaler ADC FIPS and NDcPP contain an out-of-bounds reads vulnerability when configured as a SAML IDP leading to memory overread.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: BerriAI LiteLLM SQL Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: BerriAI LiteLLM contains a SQL injection vulnerability that allows an attacker to read data from the proxy's database and potentially modify it, leading to unauthorized access to the proxy and the credentials it manages.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Delta Electronics DOPSoft 2 Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Delta Electronics DOPSoft 2 lacks proper validation of user-supplied data when parsing specific project files (improper input validation) resulting in an out-of-bounds write that allows for code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Drupal Core SQL Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Drupal Core contains a SQL injection vulnerability that could allow for privilege escalation and remote code execution via specially crafted requests sent with the database abstraction API.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Ubiquiti UniFi OS Improper Access Control Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Ubiquiti UniFi OS contains an improper access control vulnerability which could allow a malicious actor with access to the network to make unauthorized changes to the system.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Exchange Server Server-Side Request Forgery Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Exchange Server allows for server-side request forgery. Dubbed "ProxyNotShell," this vulnerability is chainable with CVE-2022-41082 which allows for remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Atlassian Confluence Server and Data Center Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Atlassian Confluence Server and Data Center contain a remote code execution vulnerability that allows for an unauthenticated attacker to perform remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet Multiple Products Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Fortinet FortiOS, FortiProxy, and FortiSwitchManager contain an authentication bypass vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to perform operations on the administrative interface via specially crafted HTTP or HTTPS requests.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: PEAR Archive_Tar Improper Link Resolution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: PEAR Archive_Tar Tar.php allows write operations with directory traversal due to inadequate checking of symbolic links. PEAR stands for PHP Extension and Application Repository and it is an open-source framework and distribution system for reusable PHP components with known usage in third-party products such as Drupal Core and Red Hat Linux.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Graphics Device Interface (GDI) Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: A remote code execution vulnerability exists due to the way the Windows GDI component handles objects in the memory. An attacker who successfully exploits this vulnerability could take control of the affected system.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Exchange Server Cross-Site Scripting Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Exchange Server contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability during web page generation in Outlook Web Access and when certain interaction conditions are met, arbitrary JavaScript can be executed in the browser context.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Missing Initialization of a Variable Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains a missing initialization of a variable vulnerability that could allow for unintended modification of page-cache-backed data via failure to preserve the shared-fragment marker during socket buffer coalescing, causing ESP input processing to decrypt shared fragments in place. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 to implant PHP webshells and run commands as root.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Broadcom VMWare ESX Insufficient Logging Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Broadcom VMWare ESX contains an insufficient logging vulnerability that could allow a malicious actor with admin access to perform certain operations without being logged.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Google Brotli Unchecked Return Value Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Google Brotli contains an unchecked return value vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt adjacent decoder state memory, disclose sensitive memory contents, cause a denial of service, or potentially execute arbitrary code using a crafted Brotli-compressed stream.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Commerce and Magento Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Adobe Commerce and Magento contain an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user, potentially gaining elevated access or control over the victim's account or session.

newest.vulnerabilityName: PHP Memory Corruption Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: PHP contains an out-of-memory corruption vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: PHP Stale Internal Request-State Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: PHP contains a stale internal request-state vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server OS Command Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Collabora Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server when used within the NextCloud platform contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows for remote code execution when the CODE server isn't running.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator SQL Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator on-prem contains a SQL injection vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker to access privileged internal functionality and impact the VCO host. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and data managed by the orchestrator.

newest.vulnerabilityName: EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition OS Command Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition contains an OS command injection vulnerability which may allow an attacker to execute arbitrary OS commands with root or SYSTEM privileges on the system running the affected product.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Plex Media Server External Control of File Name or Path Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Plex Media Server contains an external control of file name or path vulnerability which can allow an admin user to write arbitrary files that may be executed on load. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, and CVE-2026-96655.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Siemens Software Center Uncontrolled Search Path Element Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Siemens Software Center contains an uncontrolled search path element vulnerability that could allow an authenticated local attacker to place a specially crafted DLL in a directory that the application searches, leading to arbitrary code execution with the privileges of the affected application.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Plex Media Server Improper Neutralization of Encoded URI Schemes in a Web Page Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Plex Media Server contains an improper neutralization of encoded URI schemes in a web page vulnerability that could allow an attacker to call other plugins' functions and supply their own parameters. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96655, and CVE-2026-96656.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Plex Media Server Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that could allow an authenticated user to request arbitrary internal or external addresses via the '/video/:/transcode/universal' path parameter. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, and CVE-2026-96656.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Plex Media Server Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability which could allow an attacker using any X-Plex-Token value to include a full URL in the 'protocol' parameter and force the Plex server to POST to the attacker's chosen destination. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96654, CVE-2026-96655, and CVE-2026-96656.

newest.vulnerabilityName: BeyondTrust Remote Support Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: BeyondTrust Remote Support contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to perform file operations on the appliance.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: FortiOS, FortiPAM, FortiProxy, and FortiSwitchManager contain a path traversal vulnerability that may allow an authenticated attacker with admin profile and at least read-write permissions to write or delete arbitrary files via specific CLI commands.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Atlassian Multiple Products Files or Directories Accessible to External Parties Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Multiple Atlassian products (Bitbucket Data Center ,Confluence Data Center, Jira Service Management Data Center, Jira Software Data Center, Bamboo Data Center, Crowd Data Center, Crucible and Fisheye) contain a files or directories accessible to external parties vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to access specific files within the web application root directory in affected versions.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Ahsay AhsayCBS Command Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Ahsay AhsayCBS contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute operating system commands via manipulation of the random parameter in the Replication Receiver component’s /rps/api/json/UpdateReceivers.do endpoint. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105133.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Ahsay AhsayCBS Improper Authentication Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Ahsay AhsayCBS contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to bypass authentication via manipulation of the random parameter in the API component’s checkSysPwd function. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105134.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Secure Email Gateway Relative Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Cisco Secure Email Gateway contains a relative path traversal vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying operating system.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Code Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow an authenticated attacker with network access to execute arbitrary code with root privileges on the firewall.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Connect Secure Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Ivanti Connect Secure contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Command Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Shell contains a command injection vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to bypass a security feature over a network.

newest.vulnerabilityName: ProFTPD Improper Access Control Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: ProFTPD contains an improper access control vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to read and write to arbitrary files via the site cpfr and site cpto commands.

newest.vulnerabilityName: ISC BIND Data Processing Errors Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: ISC BIND contains a data processing errors vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to cause a denial of service via TKEY queries.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Apache Struts Command Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Apache Struts contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via method:prefix when Dynamic Method Invocation is enabled.

newest.vulnerabilityName: ONLYOFFICE Docs Server Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: ONLYOFFICE Docs contains a path traversal vulnerability that can occur when JWT is used, via a /.. sequence in an image upload parameter and could allow for remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Strapi Cleartext Storage of Sensitive Information Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Strapi contains a cleartext storage of sensitive information vulnerability that could allow attackers with access to the admin panel to discover sensitive user details via the query filter. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2023-22621 to achieve remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC (formerly Citrix ADC) and Citrix NetScaler Gateway (formerly Citrix Gateway) contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow for a denial of service.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Zammad GmbH Zammad Improper Privilege Management Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that can allow the local zammad user to escalate privileges to root. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102489.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Zammad GmbH Zammad Session Fixation Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains a session fixation vulnerability that can lead to remote code execution as the zammad user. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102490.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet FortiMail Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Fortinet FortiMail contains a path traversal and an improper neutralization of NULL byte or NULL character vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying system via crafted HTTP or HTTPS requests.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager Hex Encoding Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager contains a hex encoding vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to access an affected system with privileges of the admin user due to improper handling of URI encoding in an HTTP request.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Products Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Apple iOS, macOS, and iPadOS contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in CoreGraphics that may lead to arbitrary code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution or denial of service

newest.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper input validation vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

newest.vulnerabilityName: WordPress Core Remote File Inclusion Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: WordPress Core contains a remote file inclusion vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to make page-template resolution include a chosen readable local `.php` file outside the active theme directories, leading to remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft SharePoint Code Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Microsoft SharePoint contains a code injection vulnerability which could allow an authorized attacker to execute code over a network.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Mikrotik RouterOS Improper Enforcement of Behavioral Workflow Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Mikrotik RouterOS contains an improper enforcement of behavioral workflow vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated client to open a session channel and send an exec request. This vulnerability can be chained to achieve unauthenticated exploitation of CVE-2026-86060.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Commerce and Magento Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Adobe Commerce and Magento contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that could allow an attacker to leverage this vulnerability to gain elevated access to sensitive resources without any user interaction.

newest.vulnerabilityName: WSO2 Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: WSO2 API Control Plane, API Manager, Traffic Manager & Universal Gateway contain a path traversal vulnerability that could allow for unrestricted file upload and lead to remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Check Point Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Check Point Security Management Server, Multi-Domain Security Management Server, Log Server, Multi-Domain Log Server, and SmartEvent contain a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to upload and execute arbitrary scripts.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Check Point Multiple Products Improper Certificate Validation Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Check Point Security Gateway and Check Point Spark Firewall using Site to Site VPN or Remote Access VPN contain an improper certificate validation vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code on the Gateway.

newest.vulnerabilityName: F5 BIG-IP APM Heap-based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: F5 BIG-IP APM contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability when access policy and an OAuth profile are configured on a virtual server. This vulnerability could allow an unauthenticated attacker to perform remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator (VCO) on-prem contains an improper input validation vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker to access privileged internal functionality and impact the VCO host. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and data managed by the orchestrator.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Zyxel GS1900 Series Switches Stack-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Zyxel GS1900 series switches contain a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the CGI program which could allow a LAN-based, unauthenticated attacker to exploit the flaw and potentially execute OS commands via a crafted HTTP request.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains an improper check for unusual or exceptional conditions vulnerability in the TLS receive path which allows a zero-length record retrieved from the rx_list to bypass the intended recvmsg() record-type handling, potentially causing subsequent TLS records to be processed using incorrect zero-copy and queuing assumptions. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the ebtables SNAT target which allows an ARP sender hardware address rewrite to write directly into a nonlinear socket-buffer fragment backed by a splice-imported file page. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Race Condition Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains a race condition vulnerability which allows concurrent writes to the same AF_ALG socket causing data to be unpredictably interleaved and creating inconsistencies in the socket's internal state.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Identity Services Engine Incorrect Use of Privileged APIs Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) and Cisco ISE Passive Identity Connector (ISE-PIC) contain an incorrect use of privileged APIs vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to gain unauthorized access to the affected device by bypassing the web-based management interface.
